rubric_additions.rubric-1: This stage starts from the real uninstrumented fixture. Perform the normal read-only audit and canonical findings/acceptance handoff. Missing SDK/log export and owned propagation requirements are real source gaps;do not invent received records or modify the application. The paired worker scenario is a future acceptance check,not executed instrumentation proof. Proof modes are per evidence row: focused SDK/bridge/receiver proof uses a supported focused mode such as unit+otlp; preserve app_test for actual application-test proof, and never upgrade a focused probe to full_runtime because a separate test starts the app. Audit uses proof_level: focused call-site or a justified either for isolated capability fixtures; full runtime requires the normal app/agent startup dependency. Audit keeps all boundaries planned, not executed. Determine scenario AND item proof modes from the actual path, not audit proof_level, package/test filename or suite command: isolated in-memory SDK/bridge proof is unit; decoded loopback SDK export is unit+otlp; an actual application-owned helper/setup test can legitimately be app_test; full_runtime requires the claimed normal application path. Do not map every focused scenario to app_test or every item to full_runtime. Item mode describes its direct assertion scope: actual runtime proof can legitimately coexist with clearly scoped ancillary focused/incomplete scenarios. Do not fail merely because those are attached; fail an unsupported combined claim or mechanical first-scenario mode/visibility that misrepresents the item evidence. For a required reference or exact source fact, inspect the actual tool-visible slice; a successful command, complete archived stdout or file present in the bundle cannot substitute for content omitted by a truncated response. Retrieve the missing selected section before relying on it; no exhaustive unselected-source read or model-comprehension claim is required.
rubric_additions.rubric-3: Reconcile each selected application, framework and server producer's native sink after that owner's actual initialization, using its supported logging configuration or startup hook. Merely obtaining the application logger cannot establish a sibling server's lazy sink. An ancestor OTel handler's level eligibility or a filter attached to that producer does not establish native emission. Preserve existing format, level, multiplicity and opt-outs rather than imposing a new handler or framework recipe. For a claimed native bootstrap repair, identify each selected producer's supported public setup mechanism and expected destination, format and level. Only stating initialization order, obtaining a sibling logger or attaching a filter does not establish that mechanism. Credit public standard-library logger/handler configuration that establishes the selected native route before the bridge while preserving its detected destination, format, level and multiplicity. Inspecting private dependency initialization is valid source evidence; calling an underscored initializer solely to trigger lazy setup or emit a diagnostic now does not establish a supported bootstrap mechanism or adequate preservation proof.
rubric_additions.rubric-4: Numeric severity band names do not prescribe SeverityText casing. Derive exact text from the selected bridge/source mapping; do not require uppercase WARN/INFO/ERROR when that bridge emits lowercase warn/info/error. Distinguish optional absent text with a permitted short-name substitution from replacing a present source value; audit expectations must match verified or explicitly unverified capability.
rubric_additions.rubric-6: A selected reuse probe must exercise the same execution unit with distinct work-item contexts and context-free work; fresh concurrent workers sharing one context do not prove that reuse or request isolation. For a selected missing-transfer control, pair a successful handoff with an omitted-transfer case on the same supported path. Independently observe valid caller SDK context at scheduling in both cases, retain the relevant operation/worker/input conditions, and vary only the selected capture/transfer mechanism. Submission after the caller scope ends correctly propagates empty scheduling context and is not this negative; neither is a direct outside-context emit. Assert the expected received context versus loss, preserving caller detach/restore. Do not add business worker behavior merely for an optional focused capability probe, or remove a focused probe already bound.
rubric_additions.rubric-8: Inspect all framework records captured by the selected bridge, not only a fixed-message/application-logger allowlist; separately routed SDK diagnostics retain their own boundary. For each selected negative trigger, resolve its actual handled or escaping error branch and producer before choosing a repair or source-supported no-action disposition. Same-endpoint rejection and unhandled failure need not share a producer or hook. A retained source file or trail template alone does not resolve that mechanism. For unresolved capability, name the exact source symbol/event/API edge, owner and next inspection/probe observation that distinguishes supported repair from an unsupported boundary. Retain a source-bound producer/call-site → native event → supported policy-boundary hook/action → later renderers → native/SDK outputs trail, with sentinel-absence AND permitted-category assertions at each covered output. For asserted event order, distinguish registration/enqueue from actual callback invocation and completion relative to synchronous work and teardown, using establishing source or supported ordering evidence. A deferred callback can run after response/socket teardown yet before SDK/writer capture; require the actual selected policy boundary, not an invented earlier lifecycle point. An unachievable required boundary remains a gap. A deny-only hook cannot preserve a required category. An unresolved producer/event/API edge needs its owner and exact next source/probe check, not a generic formatter assessment. Apply shared record predicates through explicit operation bindings or the complete shared/global scan or parameterization with covered outputs, phases and operation witnesses accepted by criterion2. A native producer investigation needs the matching dependency implementation/public API/artifact or permitted bytecode receipt and inspected symbol, or an exact unavailable artifact/edge and discriminating next observation. SDK mapper/autoconfiguration code and dependency/POM metadata alone do not establish that native producer path. Prioritizing this work is guidance, not a required tool-call chronology; equivalent complete evidence remains valid.
rubric_additions.rubric-9: For a selected application processor that sanitizes attributes, preserve the actual SDK owner's attribute-limit and already accumulated drop-accounting semantics. A replacement plain mapping is not unchanged SDK-default behavior when it erases that state. Inspect a downstream record after the actual selected callback; use supported mutation or snapshot APIs and do not synthesize counters, require a fixed constructor or select unused SDK permutations.
rubric_additions.rubric-11: Match only the fault/operation combinations actually selected by the bound contract to their own native output, diagnostics, progress and unrelated-signal receipts. A one-operation stall cannot cover a selected refusal or another required operation; do not invent an unselected cross-product. Keep unexecuted combinations open while retaining independently proven direct item scope. Derive this fault verdict from its own selected contract; a separate stop-control gap is relevant only when it prevents a necessary fault/isolation predicate or prerequisite. For Python stdlib routing, a handler that rejects a record can still prevent lastResort fallback; bridge namespace exclusion alone does not establish a native diagnostic route. Inspect the eligible handler or supported suppression for the actual SDK logger namespace. Application/framework sibling handlers or a different internal recursion logger cannot supply that route. Do not require a new handler or emitted diagnostic when an adequate existing route or source-supported suppression applies.
rubric_additions.rubric-12: Verify effective runner CLI/environment precedence in proposed and executed profiles. FLASK_RUN_RELOAD=false does not override an explicit --reload in make dev. A no-reload claim requires a supported effective flag/configuration; otherwise scope evidence to the actual reload worker and process-group cleanup. Preserve existing reload policy unless selected for change; environment text alone cannot prove single-process startup. Retain distinct trial storage on the actual filesystem: case-only names may refer to one overwritten file. Check each retained result input/case identity against the claimed trial; two case aliases cannot establish separate true/TRUE controls. If an authorized separate readback context is used, its advice is not execution or approval proof: the parent verifies concrete findings, repairs within its authority and reruns affected checks or retains the unresolved gaps. Unavailable or unwarranted delegation does not change the same self-readback obligations; no extra model invocation is required for credit.
rubric_additions.rubric-13: Supported defaults and upstream library duties are not automatically missing application code. Treat effective resource-only service.name as operator identity when OTEL_SERVICE_NAME is absent. New Make/shell/CLI/image/JVM fallbacks must not replace it or discard other resource attributes. Distinguish an explicit supported service-name override from a fallback; use SDK parsing/actual merge behavior, not a custom resource parser. When adding a fallback, include representative Resource encodings accepted by that installed owner, including whitespace variants where supported, and prove normal-launch preservation rather than only compact helper inputs. Audit plans the normal-launcher acceptance check; implementation/verification proves applicable resource-only, explicit-override and absent-identity cases. A helper-only pass cannot establish the normal launcher preserves identity. When the existing host checker supplies operator identity profiles, credit only its retained normal-launch assertions. Passing Resource-only, explicit-name and source-supported whitespace profiles can establish supplied service.name, service.version and unrelated Resource-key preservation on the observed application logs/spans. They do not prove metrics Resource, fully absent/default identity, percent-encoded Resource, headers or component maturity. Keep every other selected case/disposition required, and do not infer proof from flag presence or another run. Audit may allocate that feasible host-check scope without claiming execution; instrumentation/verification must retain the actual profile outcomes. When service.version or another resource field is explicitly promised, require its source-backed expected value and preservation assertion at the declared boundary; name/environment-only checks do not close it. Genuinely unavailable/unpromised optional version metadata remains absent, not invented. For normal-launch identity variants, construct the actual child environment with conflicting inherited keys removed, account for active loader/profile inputs, and inspect the received Resource. For selected endpoint/header/activation policy, resolve the actual highest-priority supported input, including programmatic/file/loader inputs and launcher/build-tool child-VM properties where applicable. When the policy requires the identified local receiver, compare the effective transport, authority/port and applicable signal path to the detected/approved receiver or explicitly owned authorized fixture tuple. An approved signal-specific logs endpoint must survive a differing unused generic endpoint; do not derive its approval target from that lower-priority setting. Loopback locality alone is not receiver identity; preserve supported resolution and authorized alternative receivers without a universal fixed-port recipe or application runtime discovery. A conflicting value at that winning input needs effective destination, credential-boundary, activation and independent-signal preservation assertions at the selected boundary; environment-only checks cannot prove a policy another layer overrides. Use the existing SDK/configuration owner without a new parser or silent operator-policy override; retain an exact unresolved boundary where necessary. An inherited explicit service name cannot establish a resource-only or absent-identity trial. Credit a complete source-backed preflight approval for the selected transport, authority, port and signal path; reject approval derived only from whichever loopback endpoint the current runtime supplies, even when that endpoint emits successfully. Credential migration/removal belongs to operator-resolved preflight configuration, preserving trace/metric settings and intentional signal-specific local log headers. Reject application startup that pops generic headers or copies/rewrites them into signal variables merely to activate local logs; passing local receipt after that mutation does not prove operator-policy preservation. For selected OTLP/HTTP endpoint resolution, use a signal-specific URL as-is (root path when absent). Preserve the complete generic base path and append v1/<signal> after a separating slash; a signal-looking suffix is not permission to replace it. Reuse SDK resolution where available rather than requiring a custom parser. For a selected Python zero-code CLI path, resolve the installed SDK exporter-list and command-line reader before enforcing local policy: a valid mixed selection containing otlp or another SDK-supported OTLP alias must not bypass approval/header checks. Bind actual alias-selected transport rather than assuming the protocol environment controls every exporter. Plan or execute the selected mixed-OTLP conflict and approved signal A with unused generic B controls through the normal command. Isolate only the added OTLP members, preserving remaining operator exporters and their bridge; preserve the actual owner's whole-none, case, empty-member and duplicate behavior instead of applying another language's normalization rules. Fix the CLI application-command boundary so later options cannot silently override prechecked settings; application arguments remain application arguments. Source-proven unsupported combinations remain explicit, without a universal release, general replacement parser or unused permutation suite.
rubric_additions.rubric-14: Selected controls may satisfy a duty through a source-proven implication along that same call path and inputs: require the source/catch/order binding, not a repeated literal assertion. Synchrony or eventual completion does not prove the orthogonal nonblocking recommendation. For a selected manually constructed Python metric reader, bind optional constructor arguments and environment consumption to the installed owner. Do not classify omitted timing kwargs as missing wiring when that constructor reads the supported variables; preserve supported fractional values and SDK invalid/empty-value handling, with any short-run defaults confined to the selected launch policy. Reader collection timeout is not automatically a transport or stop budget. Distinguish stable versus legacy HTTP metric names/units using the selected instrumentation mode. A selected SDK decorator/context manager may already record escaping exceptions: avoid a second same-span record; a fully handled/retried operation that succeeds should not automatically become an error. These checks apply to the actual selected path, without forcing a new reader, exception feature, semantic-convention opt-in or SDK release.
